主要内容: UNS Energy Corporation and Tucson Electric Power Company have announced that they will be making a presentation in Las Vegas, NV on March 20, 2013. The presentation will be available at http://ir.uns.com/events.cfm starting on March 20, 2013. The presentation is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. The filing is signed by Kevin P. Larson, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, on behalf of both registrants. This disclosure is made under Regulation FD, which requires companies to disclose material information to all investors simultaneously.
